question.text: Employer's contribution to NPS under Section 80CCD(2) is allowed as a deduction up to:

answer.text: 10% of basic salary + DA (14% for central govt and in new regime)

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Section 80CCD(2), the employer's NPS contribution is deductible up to 10 percent of basic salary plus DA. For central government employees and under the new tax regime, the limit is 14 percent. The Trap: 12 percent is the EPF contribution rate, not the NPS employer deduction limit. Rs.1,50,000 is the 80C limit. 80CCD(2) is separate from the 80C umbrella. Note: The workbook also notes an overall threshold of Rs.7,50,000 for aggregate employer contributions across NPS, PF, and superannuation, so 80CCD(2) is not entirely uncapped — the percentage limit applies within this overall ceiling.
